headline: Pascarella (Forza Italia) on differentiated Imu tax on vacant homes: “Squeeze on the middle class”
summary: Forza Italia opposes Cesena mayor Enzo Lattuca's proposal for a differentiated Imu tax on vacant homes. The party calls it a squeeze on the middle class.
why: The Imu is Italy's municipal property tax, and changes to it affect property owners, rental supply and local government revenue.
